environment.configuration: 2D Release, normal -O2, KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING OFF, PCH ON, compiler cache OFF, LTO OFF, mold
environment.host_activity: External activity varied; per-sample load averages are retained.

implementation.value_types: WindowId, WindowConfig, SystemCursor, WindowChrome and WindowArea moved byte-for-byte into platform/window_types.hpp. window.hpp still includes and exports them. The window_area_at declaration moves with its value types; its implementation stays unchanged.
implementation.public_headers: App, Input and UI2 use the value header; App, UI2 and the windowed app interface forward-declare Window.
implementation.private_header: gpu_device.hpp only needs Window references, so it forward-declares Window and its implementation owns the concrete include.
implementation.consumer_repairs: Implementation, test and demo sources constructing Window or calling its methods include platform/window.hpp directly.
implementation.compatibility: Callers using Window methods or constructing the concrete class need platform/window.hpp; App/Input/UI2/windowed_app no longer export the complete class. Shared values remain available.
implementation.behavior: No function bodies, assertions, field declarations or inline definitions changed; no new forwarding functions or allocations introduced.
implementation.contracts: 6 separate platform/UI/runtime header units with component/Flecs usage requirements, PCH and unity disabled; existing renderer contracts also build.

plan_method.method: Temporarily append a comment; run Ninja -n against a copy of the generated manifest in the configured build directory to avoid dry-run CMake glob regeneration; restore bytes and nanosecond timestamps. Each phase starts with a clean plan.
plan_method.barrier: After-phase probes wait for all functional builds and all syntax checks to finish; same-directory CMake configuration and Ninja builds also run serially. The new compiler guard rejects active worktree compiler processes before header rewrites. The baseline was also collected before starting validation compilers.
plan_method.real_build_cross_check: Both completed Clang Window-header edits produced exactly their planned object sets.

timing_method.scope: window.hpp edit through hex_demo link, affected C++/PCH/archives/link included; unrelated objects/dependencies/shaders prebuilt.
timing_method.compiler_scope: Clang wall-time observations; dependency and functional validation use Clang and GCC.
timing_method.command: GNU time around taskset -c 0,2,4,6 cmake --build BUILD --parallel 4 --target hex_demo
timing_method.samples: One completed observation per version, separate phases rather than interleaved.
timing_method.interpretation: Exploratory single observations with external activity; no controlled percentage wall-speedup or clean-build improvement claim.
timing_method.restoration: Restore header bytes/timestamps; rebuild game PCHs against restored inputs and repeat smoke/API/no-change checks.
timing_method.memory: RSS is maximum child process, not concurrent aggregate.

layout_validation.scope: sizeof/alignof of 31 types including App, Input, UI2 Context/BoxStyle, Window and all five moved values; cursor/WindowArea/Flip numeric values; GCC/Clang, render-probe on/off.

syntax_selection.method: Transitive repository include consumers of window_types.hpp, app.hpp, input.hpp, ui2/context.hpp, windowed_app.hpp or gpu_device.hpp

build_metadata_refresh.issue: A separate GCC CMake configure overlapped the validation build. Objects had been rebuilt, but Ninja still held obsolete pre-change log records and rejected the after-phase clean-state check.
build_metadata_refresh.evidence: script_engine.cpp.o actual mtime 1794072869296427200 was newer than the changed input.hpp mtime 1794072234383915498, but the Ninja record remained 1794066797227533600, older than that input. No after timing was run in this rejected state.
build_metadata_refresh.remedy: Rerun configuration/build/test validation serially with no concurrent configure, then regenerate both after plans. Do not restat away dirty inputs or use stale dependency logs.
build_metadata_refresh.post_refresh_validation: 28 tests and four API reports pass per compiler after fully serialized configuration/build/test validation.

workflow_correction.finding: The prior after-phase dependency probes overlapped syntax checks and rewrote headers. This input-file race is a plausible cause of the prior transient Clang crash, not a proven explanation.
workflow_correction.change: Document the overlap in the prior record; serialize all current header probes after all compiler checks, with a process guard. Prior measurements and passing isolated retries are retained.

limits: Header-class-edit counts are specific to the recorded configurations/targets; value-header edits still require their own consumers to rebuild.
One timing observation per version with background activity is not a controlled speedup ratio or whole clean-build comparison.
Optional 3D checks are syntax/template compilation only. No Windows/MSVC or full native desktop/3D/GPU runtime validation.

steps: Prepare persistent Clang/GCC builds and prebuild the three recorded targets at base_commit with the recorded configuration; adjust paths/TMPDIR/CPU affinity.
With no active worktree compilers, run window_values_fanout.py before, window_values_layout.py before and window_values_measure.py before window.

Apply the changes, build the header contracts and finish window_values_validate.py before running window_values_syntax.py clang gcc clang-3d; repair direct includes and recheck failures with KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY. Run window_values_layout.py after.
Save changed headers under expected-<basename> files in the benchmark directory for the restore assertions. Wait for every compiler check/build to finish before running any header-edit probe.
Run window_values_fanout.py after and window_values_measure.py after window. Both import bench_compiler_guard.py to reject active worktree compilers.

import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,re,shlex,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time');base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-window-values-bench';env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(base/'kin-window-values-tmp')};selected=sys.argv[1:] or ['clang','gcc','clang-3d'];tasks=[]
# Follow repository includes backwards from the renderer/backend type headers to audit
# every known consumer, including tests and optional 3D, without PCH.
parents={}
for folder in ['engine','tests','games']:
 for path in (repo/folder).rglob('*'):
  if path.suffix not in ['.cpp','.hpp','.h','.inl']:continue
  for name in re.findall(r'^\s*#\s*include\s*[<"]([^>"]+)[>"]',path.read_text(errors='replace'),re.M):
   for candidate in [path.parent/name,repo/'engine/include'/name]:
    if candidate.is_file():
     parents.setdefault(candidate.resolve(),set()).add(path.resolve());break
pending=[repo/'engine/include/kin/platform/window_types.hpp',repo/'engine/include/kin/platform/app.hpp',repo/'engine/include/kin/platform/input.hpp',repo/'engine/include/kin/ui2/context.hpp',repo/'engine/include/kin/runtime/windowed_app.hpp',repo/'engine/src/renderer/gpu/gpu_device.hpp'];affected=set()
while pending:
 path=pending.pop().resolve()
 if path in affected:continue
 affected.add(path);pending.extend(parents.get(path,[]))
(out/'syntax-selection.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':'Transitive repository include consumers of window_types.hpp, app.hpp, input.hpp, ui2/context.hpp, windowed_app.hpp or gpu_device.hpp','sources':sorted(str(p.relative_to(repo)) for p in affected if p.suffix=='.cpp')},indent=2)+'\n')
for mode in selected:
 build=base/{'clang':'kin-build-time-clang','gcc':'kin-build-time-out','clang-3d':'kin-build-time-3d-clang'}[mode]
 for entry in json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text()):
  source=pathlib.Path(entry['file'])
  if source.suffix!='.cpp' or not source.resolve().is_relative_to(repo) or source.resolve() not in affected:continue
  only=set(filter(None,os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY','').split(',')))
  if only and str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo)) not in only:continue
  args=shlex.split(entry['command']);cmd=[];i=0
  while i<len(args):
   if args[i:i+2] in [['-Xclang','-include-pch'],['-Xclang','-include']] and i+3<len(args) and args[i+2]=='-Xclang' and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+3]:i+=4;continue
   if args[i] in ['-include','-include-pch'] and i+1<len(args) and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+1]:i+=2;continue
   if args[i]=='-o':i+=2;continue
   if args[i] in ['-c','-fpch-preprocess','-Winvalid-pch','-fpch-instantiate-templates']:i+=1;continue
   cmd.append(args[i]);i+=1
  cmd.append('-fsyntax-only');relative=str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo));tasks.append((mode,build,relative,cmd))
# Report production errors before tests to speed up dependency repairs.
tasks.sort(key=lambda t:('/tests/' in '/'+t[2],not any(x in t[2] for x in ['/renderer/','/particles/','/tilemap/','/ecs/']),t[0],t[2]))
def check(task):
 mode,build,relative,cmd=task;log=out/('syntax-'+mode+'-'+relative.replace('/','_')+'.log');started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=build,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'configuration':mode,'source':relative,'exit_code':r.returncode,'wall_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'pch':False}
 if r.returncode:print('FAIL '+mode+' '+relative+'\n'+log.read_text()[:5000],flush=True)
 return row
rows=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(check,t) for t in tasks]):
  rows.append(future.result());(out/('syntax-results-'+'-'.join(selected)+('-targeted' if os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY') else '')+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'checked':len(rows),'failures':sum(r['exit_code']!=0 for r in rows)}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(r['exit_code'] for r in rows))
